blocks.sampling: uniform shape then uniform nonoverlapping legal placement; reject duplicates
blocks.optimality: offline exact-cover minimum; placement count is not assumed optimal

path.sampling: fixed graph reconstructed from historical generator seed; new distinct endpoint pairs

hanoi.sampling: uniform distinct configurations within exact-distance strata

cube2.sampling: uniform distinct states within exact BFS depth; DBL fixed

puzzle8.sampling: uniform distinct states within exact BFS depth

evaluation: Replay actions with the task environment; stop on the first illegal action. Report execution success, strict JSON/status contract, illegal action, remaining-unsolved, truncation and service errors separately. No model-failure resampling. Success does not require a shortest plan; optimality is secondary. No tools or test-state successors in prompts. Each task uses its task-owned shared rules and complete-plan output contract.
